name: AskDash
description: AI assistant: ask anything about GD in-game

open-keybind.name: Open AskDash
open-keybind.description: Opens the AskDash chat from any screen. While playing, the level is paused first.

live-talk-keybind.name: Live talk
live-talk-keybind.description: Starts or stops live talk while playing a level: AskDash listens to your microphone and talks back. <cy>Windows only</c>.

live-talk-headphones.name: Live talk: I use headphones
live-talk-headphones.description: Lets you interrupt AskDash while it talks. Leave it off with speakers, or AskDash hears itself and stops.

live-talk-language.name: Live talk: language
live-talk-language.description: The language AskDash speaks in live talk. <cy>Auto</c> answers in the language you speak to it.

live-talk-roast.name: Live talk: roast level
live-talk-roast.description: How hard AskDash roasts your fails. <cy>Gentle</c>: light teasing, <cy>Spicy</c>: friendly roasts, <cy>Savage</c>: no mercy. Only your gameplay is roasted, never you.

live-talk-chattiness.name: Live talk: chattiness
live-talk-chattiness.description: How often AskDash speaks up on its own: on deaths, during good runs and when it's quiet. <cy>Quiet</c> only comments now and then, <cy>Chatty</c> almost never shuts up.

live-talk-subtitles.name: Live talk: subtitles
live-talk-subtitles.description: Show what AskDash says at the bottom of the screen. Only replies in English can be shown, GD fonts have no other letters.

player-skill.name: Your skill
player-skill.description: How good you are at GD, so AskDash tunes its tips to you. Sent with the game context.

api-url.name: API URL
api-url.description: AskDash server address. The OpenAI key lives on the server, never in the mod :3

send-game-context.name: Send game context
send-game-context.description: Send your player name, stats (stars, moons, demons...), linked demon list usernames, current screen and the open level (name, ID, creator, difficulty, song, attempts, best percent) to the AI so it can answer questions about "this level".

save-history.name: Save chat history
save-history.description: Keep the last 50 chat messages on your computer between game sessions. Turning it off deletes the saved history.

level-chats.name: Chat per level
level-chats.description: Keep a separate chat for each level, opened when you ask from that level. The general chat is one button away.

save-progress.name: Save level progress
save-progress.description: Keep your past sessions on each level (attempts, best percent, where you died) on your computer, so the summary and the AI can compare them. Turning it off deletes the saved progress.

session-summary.name: Session summary
session-summary.description: After leaving a level, show your attempts, best percent and where you died the most, with a button to ask the AI about it.

session-min-attempts.name: Summary min attempts
session-min-attempts.description: Only show the session summary after at least this many attempts.

use-death-tracker.name: Use Death Tracker
use-death-tracker.description: If the <cy>Death Tracker</c> mod is installed, send your deaths on the open level (per percent, start pos runs, new bests) so the AI can see where you struggle. Needs "Send game context".

demonlist-username.name: demonlist.org username
demonlist-username.description: Your name on demonlist.org (Global Demonlist), so the AI can check your rank and completions.

pointercrate-username.name: Pointercrate username
pointercrate-username.description: Your name on pointercrate.com, so the AI can check your rank and completions.
